title: Protected-change channel: the rest after the run applies a finding's protected_change
description:
Follow-up to the protected-change channel (epic-v5t incident, ticks tda/yck). Shipped: absorption never makes a protected edit a worker's tick (a carried protected_change is applied by the run at the close-out's close as a labelled commit and listed in the epic PR under 'Protected changes for the merger'; prose-only is a backlog tick outside the epic), and a PR carrying one is never merged by the run itself.

Not yet done:
1. A tick whose ONLY deliverable is a protected change: the worker commits nothing and answers DONE with a protected_change finding, which image/worker.sh reads as no-work (EXIT_NO_WORK) and the local collect as no commits. Accept it as a delivery the way a tracker-edits block is (report_proposes_tracker_edits / trackerEditDelivery).
2. The protected commit is gated only by the epic PR's CI, not by the integrated gate before it is pushed. If CI goes red on it, the red-CI repair job cannot touch the protected file. Run the integrated gate on the commit before pushing and, if it fails, do not apply: list it as proposed-not-applied in the PR.
3. An epic with no close-out tick never reaches gateCloseoutClose, so its proposals stay proposed. Apply them at the run's end instead.
4. A report-level protected-changes block (beside tracker-edits), not only a finding key, if workers reach for it.
